parameters.jsCode: const r=$input.first().json||{};const client=r.client||r.input?.client||{};const steps=r.steps||r.input?.steps||[];const start=new Date(r.start_at||r.input?.start_at||new Date().toISOString());if(!client.id) return [{json:{success:false,component_id:'C3-I',component_version:'v1',error:{code:'MISSING_CLIENT_ID',message:'client.id is required.'},next_action:'provide_client'}}];if(!Array.isArray(steps)||!steps.length) return [{json:{success:false,component_id:'C3-I',component_version:'v1',error:{code:'NO_WELCOME_STEPS',message:'steps[] is required.'},next_action:'configure_welcome_sequence'}}];const schedule=steps.map((s,i)=>({id:s.id||`step_${i+1}`,channel:s.channel||'email',template_id:s.template_id||null,due_at:new Date(start.getTime()+Math.max(0,Number(s.delay_hours||0))*3600000).toISOString(),requires_approval:s.requires_approval===true,status:'scheduled'}));return [{json:{success:true,component_id:'C3-I',component_version:'v1',client_id:client.id,schedule,next_action:'handoff_scheduled_messages_to_provider_adapters',error:null}}];
